evidence: Executed the ledger and confirmed four offered, three completed, one censored, and throughput 3/10=0.30 jobs/s.
Recomputed completed-job responses 0.4,1.0,3.0, mean 1.47, observed maximum 3.00, and one completion after its deadline.
